work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CCXCIV separates the Sandwich (Hawaiian) Islands from the eastern Oceania mission and erects them into an apostolic vicariate entrusted to the Picpus Fathers (Sacred Hearts); intitulation, narrative, erection, decernentes and non obstantibus clauses and dating clause survive. Its provenance note1 is LF52410. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF52307–52307; the source dating clause at LF52366–52370 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima tertia au- gusti anno millesimo octingentesimo quadra- gesimo quarto, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo quarto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
